article.title: Thanked For Service, Rewarded With Broken Promises. w/Steve Early
article.author: Cayden Mak
article.content: Numerous articles of impeachment relating to the war in Iran were filed against Secretary of Defense Pete Hegseth on Nov. 9. That impeachment attempt failed, but the institutional rot represented by Hegseth as the beating heart of patriarchal corruption in the Department of Defense goes much deeper than just one sick man’s mishandling of an illegal war. In their new book Courage or Complicity… Source
